title: [Link fixed] SCOOP: Ashley St. Clair sues Elon Musk for custody of new son
content:
Last night I broke the story that conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair, who recently birthed Elon Musk’s 13th child, is suing the billionaire for sole custody of their son. She also filed a petition to force Musk to legally confirm paternity.

The link in the headline of the email from last night is broken, so I wanted to re-share the working link here. Please read and share the story, and consider purchasing a paid subscription to User Mag to help me continue my work.

Subscribe now

After I broke the story, a bunch of major news outlets and big time Substackers picked it up. Unfortunately, every single one neglected to credit me. I know with People it was unintentional, so truly no hate to them, but as an independent journalist who relies 100% on user support, these decisions really affect my bottom line.

Here you can see that even though I broke the story and published it hours before anyone else, I’m being outranked by the bigger publication on Google:

I spent a significant amount of time landing this scoop and reporting this story out. Good reporting doesn’t just appear, it takes work to produce. I hope to continue to report on Musk, but chasing these stories down takes resources.

So, I am humbly asking that if you enjoy my work or find it valuable, and you have the means, please consider purchasing a yearly subscription to User Mag. Every little bit helps.

Subscribe now

Please also share the link on social media! The mainstream media has massive audience development and SEO teams. I’m doing this all myself, so every single tweet, IG post, TikTok or link sent to a friend over text makes a difference.

Thank you so much for reading User Mag. Your support means everything to me. I’ll have a fresh new edition for you coming early next week, but in the meantime please don’t hesitate to send tips and information for any stories you’d like to see me cover to hello at usermag.co.
